guideline: For CMOS, evaluators assess the naturalness of the synthesized speech in comparison to the ground truth, while for SMOS, they directly score the similarity between the synthesized speech and the initial speech prompt. Evaluators assess the naturalness of the synthesized speech in comparison to the ground truth (CMOS), directly score the similarity between the synthesized speech and the initial speech prompt (SMOS), and assess the naturalness and intelligibility of the synthesized and original speech (NMOS, IMOS).
